verdict: A quiet day: mostly studio PR breakdowns, gaming news, and thin research paper listings, with nothing that lands as a usable tool or technique for a USD/Houdini pipeline.

stories.headline: DNEG delivered 302 VFX shots for Motor City using concept-art projection onto period environments
stories.body: DNEG was sole VFX vendor on Potsy Ponciroli's 1970s revenge thriller Motor City, delivering 302 shots across 15 sequences in 7 months. The studio projected VFX supervisor Serkan Selzele's own concept art directly onto period Detroit environments, tracked gore through a multi-stage elevator fight, and simulated a thermite shower for the climax. Released theatrically July 24.
stories.why: Concept-art-as-projection-texture is a workable technique worth understanding for fast turnaround period work.

stories.headline: Junior FX artist recreates Wētā's Lagrangian wave research in Houdini
stories.body: Fred Bello, a junior FX artist, shared a breakdown of a Houdini water simulation setup based on Wētā's published research into Lagrangian wave modeling. The piece walks through his own implementation rather than reproducing Wētā's proprietary tools. No plugin or downloadable asset is mentioned, just a technique writeup.
stories.why: Useful reference if building custom ocean or wave FX setups in Houdini VEX.

stories.headline: My Full AI Workspace - A Year in the Making, Now Yours for Free
stories.body: The release of Mr. Mak Workspace, an open-source environment designed to orchestrate multiple terminal-based AI agents within a visual project management frontend for 3D workflows.
stories.why: This workspace serves as a local orchestration layer. A VFX TD could adapt the MCP pattern to write Houdini-specific servers, allowing agents to manipulate .hip files or USD stages directly through the terminal interface.

stories.headline: GPT-6 Astra + After Effects Creates Motion Graphics in Minutes!
stories.body: Integration of an agentic LLM (Astra) directly with the After Effects API, allowing users to describe complex motion tasks (physics, rigging, re-layouts) which are then executed as native, editable AE layers and keyframes.
stories.why: While AE-focused, the logic of using an agent with specific 'skills' (scripts/plugins) to handle boilerplate rigging and layout tasks is highly applicable to Houdini or Maya pipelines. A VFX TD could implement similar agentic patterns using the Houdini Python API to automate recurring setup tasks or variations.
